WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.death_state,
    COUNT(*) as state_count
  FROM hall_of_fame hf
  INNER JOIN player p ON hf.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.death_state
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(state_count) as avg_count FROM state_counts
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.state_count,
    oa.avg_count as overall_avg
  FROM state_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE sc.state_count > oa.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(state_count) as avg_count,
  AVG(state_count - overall_avg) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
-- Returns one row: average count of Hall of Fame records for states above the overall average, and their average excess over that overall average
